name: SikaSwell® A
summary: SikaSwell® A is an acrylic sealing profile which swells in contact with water to seal all types of joints and penetrations in concrete. It has a rectangular profile and is available in several sizes.
metaDescription: SikaSwell® A is an acrylic sealing profile which swells in contact with water to seal all types of joints and penetrations in concrete. It has a rectangular profile and is available in several sizes.
attributes: Can be applied on different substrates
Can swell into cracks and gaps
Resistant against water and various chemical substances
Adaptable to fit many different detailing tasks
usage: Pipe and steel work penetrations through walls and floor slabs
Construction joints in cable ducts, etc.
Around all types of penetrations through concrete

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 36 months from the date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: Dimensions
items.text:
Type | Width | Height
SikaSwell® A 2005 | 20 mm | 5 mm
SikaSwell® A 2010 | 20 mm | 10 mm
SikaSwell® A 2015 | 20 mm | 15 mm
SikaSwell® A 2025 | 20 mm | 25 mm

items.label: System structure
items.text:
The following system products must be used:
SikaSwell® A
SikaSwell® S-2 Sealant

items.label: Swelling
items.text:
Time | Demineralised water | 5 % saline solution
3 days | ~100 % | ~60 %
7 days | ~150 % | ~100 %
14 days | ~200 % | ~120 %
21 days | ~220 % | ~140 %

items.label: Swelling pressure
items.text: ≤ 16 bars after 3 days stored in tap water

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: Dry or matt damp. Do not apply in construction joints when standing water is existing.

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text:
+5 °C min.
For installation below +5 °C ambient temperature, special measures are required in accordance with relevant national regulations and Sika guidelines

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text:
+5 °C min.
For installation below +5 °C substrate temperature, special measures are required in accordance with relevant national regulations and Sika guidelines

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: The substrate must be sound, clean, dry or matt damp, free from all surface contaminants

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
Existing Concrete
All loose particles, release agents, laitance, paint, rust and other poorly adhering materials must be removed by suitable hand or mechanical preparation.
Freshly cast concrete
During concreting, compact well around SikaSwell® A profiles to provide a dense concrete without any honeycombing or voids.
Surfaces which are excessively rough can be susceptible to leaking. It is recommend to smoothen the freshly cast concrete with a batten where the sealing profile is to be placed.
